mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates strong demand, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST increase, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a supply-side contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months, combined with a stable or decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases & FEDFUNDS stable/decreasing over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months, combined with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE stable/decreasing over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over a single month signals supply-side constraints amidst inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases & CPIAUCSL increases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
